signal: Maven AGI raised a $50M Series B led by Dell Technologies Capital in February 2026 to scale its enterprise CX AI agents

email.body1:
Josh, saw Maven AGI closed a $50M Series B led by Dell to scale the enterprise CX agents.

Post-raise, the volume of accounts your SDRs need to touch usually jumps faster than the team can ramp, and follow-up speed is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so your reps cover far more without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to Maven AGI's top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Josh, quick follow-up for Maven AGI.

When the account list grows post-raise, ramp time and response speed decide how much of it your team actually works. The teams that win automate the research and first drafts so reps spend their hours on live conversations, not tab-switching.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Josh, last bit of proof for Maven AGI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR team's reply rate likely compares to other recently funded startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Josh, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up without adding SDRs is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a raise, and I know ramping the team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I will tailor it to Maven AGI either way.
